episodes.title: A Chance Introduction
episodes.source_range: case one, zero minutes forty four seconds to three minutes twenty seconds
episodes.summary: Doctor Watson returns wounded from Afghanistan, meets an old acquaintance in a public house, and hears about a strange man at the hospital who has spent the morning beating a corpse with a stick.
episodes.end_hook: A man who beats a dead body with a stick, to learn whether you can bruise the dead. Watson wants to meet him.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Warm retrospective narration, then easy conversation in a quiet public house.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There is no city in the world so attractive as the one you call home, and never more attractive than when you return to it after long and difficult years in other parts of the world.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: My name is Doctor John Watson. I had served in the more remote regions of Afghanistan. I was wounded there, in the shoulder, and I carried home a fever that very nearly finished what the bullet had begun. The Army discharged me with specific instructions to rest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The sight of London was already working its quiet cure. As I walked the familiar streets that autumn, with no duties and no particular direction, I felt myself becoming a man again rather than a casualty.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There was, however, the question of money. A wounded officer's pension is a careful sort of income. It will keep a man in a hotel for a fortnight or in lodgings for a year, and I had already spent rather more of the fortnight than I care to admit. I had begun, that week, to read the advertisements at the back of the newspapers with real attention.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I never once suspected that a chance introduction, made in an ordinary public house on an ordinary afternoon, would lead me into the most amazing adventure of my entire life.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Watson. Good heavens. You were wounded.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I was. I am a great deal better than I was.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: You look it. Sit down, sit down. What are your plans now?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Nothing at all, at the moment. I am looking for lodgings. I am trying to solve the whole problem of comfortable quarters at a reasonable price.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: That is odd.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Is it?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: You are the second man today to use that exact expression.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Who was the other?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: A fellow doing some work in the chemical laboratory at the hospital. He wants to share rooms and cannot find anyone to share them with.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Then he has my sympathy, and possibly my address. Has he found somewhere?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: He has. That is rather the trouble. He has found a set of rooms he likes very much and cannot manage the rent alone, and he has been looking for a fortnight for somebody to go halves with him.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: A fortnight seems a long while to look.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: It does rather, does it not.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Well, I should not mind sharing a flat, if he is all right.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Ah?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: He is rather strange.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Strange in what way? What is wrong with him?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Nothing is wrong with him. Holmes is his name. Sherlock Holmes.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: And I saw him this morning. He was doing some research with a corpse.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: That is hardly strange. So do I.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: He was beating it with a stick.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: He was what?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Beating it. With a stick. For a considerable time.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: In heaven's name, why?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: I asked him. He said he wanted to find out whether it is possible to inflict a bruise on a body after death.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I set down my glass. In four years of military surgery I had examined a great many injuries and had been asked to say, more than once, whether a wound had been received before a man died or after it. I had given my opinion each time. I had never once been certain, and neither had anybody else.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Stamford. Do you understand what he is doing?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Beating a corpse with a stick, old man.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: He is settling a question that has hanged men and acquitted them for as long as there have been courts.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And is it? Possible?

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Do you know, I did not think to ask him.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I have thought about that answer many times since. Stamford had stood in a room with a man conducting an experiment that no one in the history of medicine had thought to conduct, and the only question that had occurred to him was whether the man was sane.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I do not blame him for it. I should very likely have done the same a year earlier. But I had come home from a place where the difference between a careful answer and a confident one was the difference between a man walking free and a man being shot, and I had lost my appetite for confident answers.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Stamford.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I should like to meet him.

episodes.title: You Have Been in Afghanistan
episodes.source_range: case one, three minutes twenty seconds to six minutes
episodes.summary: Watson meets Holmes mid experiment. Holmes has devised the first reliable test for bloodstains, greets Watson by naming a country he has never mentioned, and offers him rooms in Baker Street.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Watson, home wounded from Afghanistan and looking for lodgings, hears of a strange man at the hospital who beats corpses to study bruising, and asks to meet him.
episodes.end_hook: Holmes explains how he knew about Afghanistan, and the explanation is somehow more astonishing than the trick.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Holmes is rapid and delighted, talking past Watson. Watson is polite and completely lost.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: We found him in the chemical laboratory, bent over a bench of glassware, and he did not look up when we entered.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It works. Do you understand me? It works.

lines.speaker: STAMFORD
lines.text: Mister Holmes, this is Doctor Watson.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You are a doctor. Then you will realise you have just walked into the greatest chapter in the history of forensic medicine. Look at it. A test for haemoglobin that begins with this and ends with that.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I am afraid I do not.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You do not what?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Realise what it means.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It means a revolution in criminal investigation. Consider the general problem. A man is suspected of a crime months after it is committed. They find stains on his clothing, on his linen, on a weapon, and they cannot say whether it is blood, or mud, or rust. They have never been able to say. Now they can.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: The old test was guaiacum, was it not.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: The old test was guaiacum, and it was clumsy, and it was uncertain, and it required a quantity of fresh blood that no criminal has ever been obliging enough to leave behind. Mine requires a stain the size of a pinhead and it does not care how old the stain is. A year. Ten years.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Ten years.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Ten years, Doctor. Think what that does to a man who has been sleeping soundly for nine of them.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Had this test been in existence a year ago, the man Bishop would most certainly have hanged. And that goes for Mason of Bradford, and for Muller, and for half a dozen others walking about at this moment in perfect health.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Who are these people?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Murderers, Doctor Watson. How do you do. I am delighted to meet you. You have been in Afghanistan, I perceive.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I had not mentioned Afghanistan. I had not mentioned the Army. I had not, so far as I could recall, mentioned anything at all except my own name, and that had been said by somebody else.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: How on earth did you know that?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is written all over you.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: That is not an answer.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: No. It is not, is it. Stamford tells me you are looking for someone to share a flat.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Holmes. I must know. How did you know I had come from Afghanistan?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is obvious you are a doctor. That much I had from Stamford, so I will not claim it. But you carry yourself with the air of a military man, therefore an army doctor.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You have acquired a heavy sunburn, and I know it is not your natural colouring because your wrists are white. Your face tells me you have been ill, badly and recently. I would say some manner of tropical fever.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And the wound?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You hold your left arm stiffly, as though the shoulder has been damaged and has not forgiven you for it. So. Where in the world does an army doctor acquire a tropical fever, a sunburn and a wounded shoulder, all at once, and come home this season to be discharged?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Afghanistan.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Afghanistan.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I have been asked since whether I felt made a fool of. I did not. What I felt, standing in that laboratory with my hat still in my hand, was something closer to relief. Every one of those observations had been available to me. I had looked at my own wrists that morning. The difference between us was not that he saw more than I did. It was that he troubled to put it together.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: It is remarkably simple, when you explain it.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It always is. That is the great disappointment of my profession. I explain a thing and it stops being remarkable, and the person I explained it to concludes that anyone could have done it.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I did not say that.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: No. You did not. I noticed.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I think you will like the flat. It is in Baker Street. We could go round this afternoon and look at it.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Yes. Yes, I should like that.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Good. Do you mind if I play the violin?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Now?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: When we are sharing the rooms.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Oh. Of course not. I like a bit of good music.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Excellent. I am not very good.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: We examined the rooms at two two one B, Baker Street that afternoon, and I moved in on the following day.

episodes.title: A Classification of Mister Holmes
episodes.source_range: case one, six minutes to nine minutes forty five seconds
episodes.summary: Watson discovers that Holmes does not know the Earth goes round the Sun, and intends to forget it again. He draws up a private classification of the man's knowledge, and then watches Holmes identify a stranger through a window.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Watson met Holmes at the hospital laboratory, was told he had been in Afghanistan by a man who had never met him, and took rooms with him at two two one B, Baker Street.
episodes.end_hook: A messenger arrives from the police, and Holmes has named the man's entire career before he has opened his mouth.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Domestic and comic, then sharpening abruptly when the visitor arrives.
episodes.production_note: PREDICTED WEAK EPISODE. The classification section is a list rather than a scene. No stakes, no antagonist. Predicted before measurement, deliberately not repaired.

scenes.title: Twenty Four Hours
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I had at that point known Sherlock Holmes for twenty four hours.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In that time I had learned that he kept no regular hours, that he received no letters from family, and that the chemical apparatus on the sitting room table was not to be moved for any reason whatsoever, including cleaning, including fire.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His powers of perception were fantastic. His personality was the least predictable I had ever encountered. Between the two of them they kept me in a state of more or less constant surprise, and I began, in self defence, to take notes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He rose at four one morning and did not rise at all the next. He would speak for an hour on the varieties of cigar ash and then not speak for a day and a half. Our landlady formed the view within a week that he was a gentleman of independent means recovering from a disappointment, and I did not correct her, chiefly because I had no better theory of my own.

scenes.title: The Solar System
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Holmes. You cannot be serious.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I am entirely serious.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Every schoolchild in England knows that the Earth travels round the Sun.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Well. Now I know it too. And I shall do my best to forget it.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Forget it?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Why should I remember it? It is a natural phenomenon. Is it important? Does it affect us? If you told me tomorrow that the Earth went round the Moon instead, would it make the smallest difference to my work, or to yours, or to the price of a cab from here to Charing Cross?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Put that way. No.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Then it is useless information, and I shall do my best to forget it. I advise you to do the same.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At times I thought the man was joking, and having a little fun at my expense. I soon learned he was in dead earnest.

scenes.title: The Classification
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Unknown to him, I drew up a brief classification of the man's knowledge.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Literature. Nothing. Philosophy. Nothing. Astronomy. Nothing, and shortly to be less than nothing. Politics. Feeble. Botany. Variable, and entirely dependent on whether the plant in question could be used to poison somebody.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Chemistry. Profound. Anatomy. Accurate, though unsystematic. Sensational literature. Immense. He appeared to know the details of every serious crime committed in the last hundred years.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I read the list back to myself and found that I had described a man who was ignorant of everything the world agreed was worth knowing, and expert in everything it agreed was not. I put the paper in a drawer. I did not throw it away.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I have kept it. It is in front of me now, in a hand rather steadier than the one I write with these days, and there is a note at the bottom in pencil which reads, in its entirety, what is he for.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I had the answer within the week, and I have spent the rest of my life setting it down.

scenes.title: The Retired Sergeant of Marines
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: We have a visitor.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Coming here?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Coming here. A retired sergeant of Marines, I should say.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: That is one of the wildest statements I have ever heard. How can you possibly know that? You have never seen the man.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I have seen the man. I have not spoken to him. Ask him yourself, if you like.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Gentlemen. I have a message for Mister Sherlock Holmes.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Forgive me. Would you mind telling me your occupation?

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Not at all, sir. I am a civil servant, employed by the police department.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And how long have you been with the police department?

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Just under two years, sir.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And before that?

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Before that I was a sergeant in the Marines. Good day, gentlemen.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: An interesting letter. A very interesting letter indeed. Perhaps you would care to come with me.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: To catch a murderer.

episodes.title: A Matter of Your Name, Please
episodes.source_range: case one, nine minutes forty five seconds to fourteen minutes
episodes.summary: Holmes and Watson reach the Cunningham house. A man has been stabbed in his own front room, his mother has already decided who did it, and Inspector Lestrade has already agreed with her.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Watson catalogued Holmes's strange knowledge, then watched him identify a police messenger as a retired sergeant of Marines through a window. The messenger brought a letter, and Holmes invited Watson to come and catch a murderer.
episodes.end_hook: There is no motive. The woman gains nothing by his death, and the mother wants her hanged regardless.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Brisk, procedural, with grief breaking through underneath.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: We took a cab across the river and I spent the journey asking questions that were not answered. Holmes had read the letter twice, put it in his pocket, and thereafter looked out of the window with the expression of a man attending a concert.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: You might tell me where we are going.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: To a house where a man was found dead on his own carpet last night with a knife in his chest and a young woman standing over him holding it.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Good heavens. Then it is perfectly clear.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is perfectly clear. That is what troubles me. Test your own powers of observation on the way in, Doctor. I should be interested to know what you make of the carpet.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There was a constable at the door and a small crowd on the pavement being encouraged to disperse, which they were doing at the speed of people who have no intention of dispersing.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Move along there, please. Nothing to see. Move along.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Good morning.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: A matter of your name, please, sir.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Sherlock Holmes. This is Doctor Watson.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Oh. Quite all right, sir. Inspector Lestrade gave instructions to admit you.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Has the body been removed?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: It has, sir. The medical examiner has only just finished with it.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Of course it has. And these gentlemen have been walking about in here since dawn.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Is that a difficulty?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: The police forces of the world seem to have organised the moving of things about into a science. They have not yet organised the leaving of things alone. It is a much harder discipline and it catches a great many more murderers.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He went down on one knee at the edge of the carpet and stayed there for some time without touching anything at all.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: The pile has been disturbed. Here, and here, and again by the leg of that chair. Somebody has moved across this floor with a good deal of force behind them.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: A struggle.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: A struggle, Doctor. Remember that we found one. It will be inconvenient later.

lines.speaker: MOTHER_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: I do not know. I swear to you I do not know. I tried to help him. Do you not believe me?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That was the young woman, and she was speaking to a much older one, who sat entirely upright in a chair by the window and did not look at her.

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: I did what I could. Anyone would have done the same.

lines.speaker: MOTHER_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: You know that is not true. And I know it. And you know that I know it.

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: You hate me. You have always hated me.

lines.speaker: MOTHER_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: Yes. I can, and I do. My son has been murdered, and there is the murderess, and I can only be grateful that she gains nothing at all by her crime.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The older woman turned to us for the first time, and I have rarely seen a face so completely emptied of everything but purpose.

lines.speaker: MOTHER_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: They were engaged. Not with my blessing. Your duty now is to convict her.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: The angle of incision. What was it?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Upward, I should say, from the state of the wound. And the force considerable. The blade went in to the hilt.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: How long before loss of consciousness?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: That is difficult to say. Two minutes. Perhaps three or four before death.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Three or four. Thank you, Doctor.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Forgive the interruption.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Inspector. I should have preferred an invitation before the body was moved.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I thought you would be interested, Holmes. May I introduce, this is my friend Doctor Watson.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You are stuck.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I beg your pardon.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You said you thought I would be interested. You have never once thought I would be interested. You are in a jam, Inspector, and it is a small enough word for it.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: That is not exactly true, Holmes. I have done you a favour. It is an interesting case. There are one or two unexplained details, but I do not believe it will be long before we are clear. Our principal problem is that there is no motive.

episodes.title: They Were Married
episodes.source_range: case one, fourteen minutes to nineteen minutes forty five seconds
episodes.summary: Holmes supplies the motive Lestrade was missing, and in doing so hands the police the rope to hang an innocent woman. Then he explains how he knew, and nobody thanks him for it.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: At the Cunningham house Holmes found signs of a struggle on the carpet, listened to a mother accuse her son's fiancee of murder, and learned from Lestrade that the case had no motive at all.
episodes.end_hook: The woman had a prison record and now she has a motive. Lestrade has his case, and Holmes has begun to look unhappy.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Holmes is quick and pleased with himself, and then abruptly is not.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: This would be a clear cut case if only she had a reason. There happened to be a constable in the street outside the whole of that evening, and he is quite certain that nobody entered this house except her.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Then who benefits by his death?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Nobody. That is the trouble. The estate was left in such a way that if he died before he married, everything went to charity.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: My dear Inspector Lestrade.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Holmes.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: He did not die before he married.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The room went very quiet. The young woman raised her head.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: He did not die before he married this young lady, and the man whose body was carried out of here had been married for at least a week. In the event of his death I imagine everything passes to her.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Is this true? Are you married to him?

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Then you do benefit by his death.

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: I only know that I did not kill him. I swear to you that I did not kill him.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Where were you married?

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: At Brighton. We went down for the weekend.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Then why did he say nothing about it?

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: I do not know. He asked me not to. He said there was something he had to finish first, and that after that it would not matter who knew.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I am afraid, young lady, I shall have to ask you to accompany me to headquarters.

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: May I tell his mother?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: You may not.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Holmes. How did you know they were married?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: The dead man's hands. There was the remains of a sunburn on them, and the fading mark of a ring that was not yet in place. A ring worn habitually leaves an indentation. This one had not had time to.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: A new ring.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: A new ring, on a hand that has spent a weekend somewhere with more sun in it than London has managed since April. Brighton explains the whole thing, and Brighton is where one goes to be married quickly and quietly.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I did not notice any of that.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You were looking at the wound. It is what you are trained to look at. The young lady's hands, by the way, were sunburned to precisely the same degree.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: The same weekend.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It would appear so, would it not.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Well now. It seems this girl has a record. Nine months in the women's prison at Holloway, some five years ago. Employed as a governess and convicted of stealing three hundred pounds from her employer.

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: That is quite true. I knew you would find it out sooner or later.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: You did not think to mention it.

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: I made a mistake five years ago and I paid for it. Peter knew all about it before we were married. I never tried to hide it from him.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: He did not know what else you had in mind.

lines.speaker: MRS_CUNNINGHAM
lines.text: I had nothing else in mind, except that I loved him.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Lestrade looked at Holmes, and Holmes looked at the window, and said nothing whatever.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I am afraid I must ask you to go with the officers.

episodes.title: A Thousand Pounds a Week
episodes.source_range: case one, nineteen minutes forty five seconds to twenty six minutes
episodes.summary: Holmes finds a chequebook nobody thought to open, Lestrade refuses to reopen a closed case, and so Holmes breaks into the house at night and is still there when the murderer comes home with a revolver.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Holmes proved the dead man had secretly married, which gave the accused woman the motive the police were missing. Her old prison record did the rest, and she was taken to headquarters.
episodes.end_hook: The brother confesses to a room he believes he is about to empty, and Holmes has been standing in the dark listening to every word of it.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Tense and quiet in the dark house. The confession is calm, which makes it worse.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: That is how I like my cases. Fast and simple.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Then you will enjoy this. Peter Cunningham drew a cheque for one thousand pounds six weeks ago. And five weeks ago. And four, and three, and two.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: All of it in cash.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I do not get your point. He was a very rich man.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: It is a great deal of cash, Inspector.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: It was his own money. I suppose he could do as he liked with it.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Five thousand pounds in cash, in five weeks, drawn by a careful man who told nobody he had married. And a week before he died he began to tell his wife that there was something he had to finish first.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Holmes, you are trying to start something that does not exist. And when there is not a mystery, you have to make one.

scenes.title: I Will Not Stand For It

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You are right. I am not happy.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Now look here.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: There are marks on that carpet indicating a struggle. The man whose body was carried out of that house was over six feet in height. If he had struggled with the young woman you have in a cell, I do not think he would have lost.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: She surprised him.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: He was expecting her. He had asked her to come.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Then she sneaked up on him.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: And stabbed him in the chest. How does one sneak up on a man and stab him in the chest, Inspector? I should be glad to learn it.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Look here, Holmes. That girl is in a cell, and she is guilty, and she is going to hang, and that is the end of the case. I will not stand for any more of it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: We walked out into the street. Holmes said nothing for two streets together, which in my short experience of him was a very bad sign indeed.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: What time is it?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: A little after ten.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Then you might take a stroll with me. I should like to investigate this afternoon's affair a little further.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I thought you had forgotten about it.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Not at all. I have been thinking about it all evening.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: To the Cunningham house.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: You have made an appointment?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I have not.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Then who are we going to see?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Nobody, I hope.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Holmes, you cannot break into a house.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Because it is against the law. That is why not.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Yes. It is a fair point and I have considered it at some length.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Where did you get that key?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is not a key exactly. It is a burglar's key. I have several. Mind the step.

scenes.title: He Married Her To Prove It

lines.speaker: RALPH
lines.text: Do not move. Either of you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I have been shot at in Afghanistan by men who meant it, and I can tell you there is a particular quality to a voice that has already decided.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Good evening. You will be the brother.

lines.speaker: RALPH
lines.text: Looking for what, precisely?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Bank statements. Anything indicating a passage of money out of Peter Cunningham's account and into somebody else's.

lines.speaker: RALPH
lines.text: You will not find it. I burned it.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You were blackmailing him. His engagement to a woman with a prison record was a perfect opportunity to extract a little money.

lines.speaker: RALPH
lines.text: It would have gone on for years if he had not been such a bullhead. He married her to prove to me that my blackmail would not stop him. And then he withheld the fact of it to give me one week to get out of the country before he exposed me.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And the money?

lines.speaker: RALPH
lines.text: Buying up my promissory notes. I was being pressed, Mister Holmes.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: So you killed him, and the jailbird made a perfect suspect.

lines.speaker: RALPH
lines.text: Perfect. And you and Doctor Watson make perfect burglars. When I report your deaths to the police they can hardly blame a man for defending his own home.

episodes.title: The Newspapers Got It Wrong
episodes.source_range: case two, zero to three minutes ten seconds
episodes.summary: The Cunningham case closes with Lestrade taking the credit and being genuinely embarrassed about it. Then a murder is reported at the home of a senior man in the Foreign Office, and Watson is invited along as a medical man.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Holmes broke into the Cunningham house at night, found the brother waiting with a revolver, and heard a full confession to blackmail and murder before a shot was fired.
episodes.end_hook: A man is dead in a Foreign Office study, and the Inspector wants a medical opinion and a suggestion or two, though he will not call it that.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Comic and warm at Scotland Yard, turning official the moment the message arrives.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The brother was tried in the spring. The young widow was released within the week, and I never learned what became of her, which is a thing I have regretted more as I have got older.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: As for the newspapers, they were unanimous. They gave the credit for the whole affair to Inspector Lestrade of Scotland Yard.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Doctor Watson. I did not expect the pleasure of seeing you again so soon. Will you kindly read that.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Read it.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Oh. Oh, I see. Yes.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Disgraceful, sir. Absolutely disgraceful.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Well, I.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And I am glad you agree, so that I can say it to you personally. You and I both know it was Sherlock Holmes who solved the Cunningham case. If it had not been for his brilliance and his persistence the facts would never have come to light at all.

scenes.title: He Does Not Care Who Gets The Credit

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And I think it is scandalous, sir, that the newspapers should have given me the whole of the credit and said so very little about his magnificent achievement. What do you think, Doctor?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I. Yes. I absolutely agree with you.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I am glad you are on my side, Doctor. I am very glad you have taken it that way. What does Holmes think?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Oh, he does not mind. You know Holmes. He does not care who gets the credit.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Such a modest fellow.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: He is a great many things, Inspector.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Look, you must give him my kind regards, and tell him that although I know he thinks nothing whatever about it, I intend to get the newspapers to put the facts straight.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: That is very good of you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And the extraordinary thing, which I did not understand for some years, is that he meant every word of it.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And what is Holmes doing these days?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: The last time I saw him he was playing about with a great many ink smudges and talking about the fingers of criminals.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Fingers.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Fingerprints, Inspector. He says it is the coming thing.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Nonsense.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There was a knock at the door then, and a sergeant came in with a paper, and everything in the room changed temperature.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: A murder reported, sir. At the home of Lord Beryl.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Lord Beryl of the Foreign Office?

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Himself, sir.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I shall be right with you. Excuse me, Doctor.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Yes, of course.

scenes.title: Perhaps A Suggestion Now And Then

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: The Foreign Office. This is going to be a tricky situation, Doctor, and no mistake.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Can I be of any assistance?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: I did not think so.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And then, of course, as a medical man. Mind you, I do not know what to expect, but I think you would be of invaluable assistance.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Say no more.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: There is a carriage waiting outside. And perhaps you would care to acquaint Sherlock Holmes with what has happened.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I do not know myself what has happened.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: No. Quite. But as you say, the people involved make this case rather delicate. Perhaps a little suggestion now and then might help facilitate matters. One never knows.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: One never does, Inspector.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So a message went to two two one B, Baker Street, and I got into the carriage, and it is worth recording that Inspector Lestrade had asked for Holmes's help twice in one conversation without once using the word.

episodes.title: Some Poisons Do Good
episodes.source_range: case two, three minutes ten seconds to five minutes thirty five seconds
episodes.summary: The message reaches Baker Street and finds Holmes entirely uninterested in it. He is halfway through an extract of pygmy poison, and he would rather explain his apparatus to a police constable over a cup of tea.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: The newspapers gave Lestrade the credit for the Cunningham case, which embarrassed him. Then a murder was reported at Lord Beryl's house, and Watson was sent ahead as a medical man.
episodes.end_hook: A man is lying dead across London, and Sherlock Holmes is asking a constable whether he takes milk.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Unhurried and domestic, deliberately at odds with the urgency elsewhere.
episodes.production_note: PREDICTED WEAK EPISODE. Delays the case without advancing it and has no antagonist present. Predicted before measurement, deliberately not repaired.

scenes.title: A Message For Mister Holmes
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Mister Holmes?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: There has been a murder committed at the home of Lord Beryl. Inspector Lestrade and Doctor Watson have already gone there.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And Holmes, according to the constable's own account, which he gave me afterwards at some length and with considerable feeling, turned back to the bench and did not move for the better part of a minute.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Would you care for some tea?

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Some tea, sir?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is what is making that noise. Come along, I want to have a look at this.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Sir, the Inspector.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: The Inspector has a body, a house, a widow and eleven constables. What he does not have is a hypothesis, and he will not have one before four o'clock. Do you take milk?

scenes.title: The Apparatus
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: What is all this over here, sir?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Leaves. Subtropical. They were sent to me by a friend in that part of the world. The essence passes through this tube here, across the table, and is condensed in that retort there.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: And the stuff in the bottom, sir? The slime.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: That acts as a catalytic agent. It combines the essence of the leaves with the dark tarlike substance you can see settling at the base.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: And what is that when it is finished, sir?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: A poison used by certain peoples for their arrows, and one of the most efficient in the world. A quantity smaller than a grain of rice will stop a man's heart between one step and the next.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: That is a shocking thing to have on a table, sir, if you will pardon me.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is. I am working on it because I believe certain poisons, taken in the correct dose, may have beneficial rather than fatal effects.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Beneficial.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: The difference between a medicine and a murder is arithmetic, Sergeant. Very little else.

scenes.title: Do You Take Milk
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Sugar?

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Two, sir. Thank you, sir.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Help yourself.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Very good of you, sir.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The constable told me later that they sat for eleven minutes. He told me the exact figure. He had been watching the clock on the mantel with the fixed attention of a man who expects to be asked about it in writing.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Begging your pardon, Mister Holmes. But there is a gentleman dead.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: There is.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: And you are not in any particular hurry about it.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: May I ask why not, sir?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Because the dead gentleman will still be dead at four o'clock, and by four o'clock Inspector Lestrade will have decided what happened, and it is a great deal easier to take a wrong idea away from a man than to stop him having it.

scenes.title: It Is Always Ready
scenes.location: Two two one B, Baker Street

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Will you come now, sir?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I will come now.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: And the experiment, sir?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It will keep. It is a very patient sort of process.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Only there is a flame under it, sir.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: There is. Turn it down as you go, would you, there is a good fellow. No. Leave it. I shall want it at the temperature it is.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I record that exchange exactly as the constable gave it to me, because of what happened at the end of the week. He remembered it exactly. So, I am obliged to say, did the fire brigade.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Now then. Lord Beryl of the Foreign Office. A man dead in the study of somebody whose correspondence is worth more than his silver. That will not be a robbery, Sergeant.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: What will it be, sir?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: A transaction.

episodes.title: My Wife Has Confessed
episodes.source_range: case two, five minutes thirty five seconds to eight minutes forty seconds
episodes.summary: Lord Beryl is kept waiting half an hour in his own house before being told that his wife has confessed to shooting a man in his study. Lestrade lays out a complete and satisfying case, and every word of it rests on one assumption nobody has examined.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Holmes received news of the murder at Baker Street and spent the next quarter of an hour making tea for the constable who brought it, on the grounds that Lestrade would need a wrong idea removed later.
episodes.end_hook: Shot in the back of the head, at close range, with her own countryman's revolver lying beside him. There is no possible defence, which is exactly what is wrong with it.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Formal, controlled, with real distress under the good manners.

scenes.title: I Demand To See My Wife

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: Inspector Lestrade. I demand to see my wife. You have kept me waiting half an hour in my own house, and I should now like an explanation.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: You are entitled to one, sir.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: I am aware that a man named Oberstein was found dead in my study. I was informed of that at the Ministry. It is a tragedy, of course, and an embarrassment, but I do not see.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Lord Beryl. Your wife has confessed to shooting him.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I have seen men take bad news in a great many ways. Lord Beryl took it the way a man takes a step that is not there.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: That is why I could not allow you to see her. We were taking her statement.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: What does she say?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Apart from the confession itself, she refuses to say anything at all. You may go in now, if you wish.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Who was he, Inspector? The dead man.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Carl Oberstein. Austrian, originally. For a number of years he has been a freelance agent.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Meaning what, exactly?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Meaning he bought and sold anything he could get his hands on, and he got his hands on a great deal. Naval estimates. Treaty drafts. Whatever a man in a position of trust could be persuaded to part with.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And he came here.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: He came here. He met Lord Beryl once, last week, and by his lordship's own account he was shown the door inside five minutes.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And came back.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And came back, Doctor, and got himself shot in the back of the head for it.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: I examined the body before it was removed. The entire back of the skull is gone. Death would have been instantaneous.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Did you find the bullet?

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: No. The police surgeon will do that. It had not come out.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And there is the whole case. A shot in the back of the head removes any possible chance that Lady Beryl may have had of claiming self defence.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: The weapon?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: A Schmidt, thirty eight calibre, lying beside the body where she dropped it. Austrian make. And Lady Beryl is Austrian born.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: That is rather damning.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: It is a great deal more than rather. She was found bending over him. She has confessed. The weapon is her countryman's. Doctor, in twenty years I have not been handed a case this tidy.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Will that be all, sir?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: That will be all, Wilkins. You have been a great help this afternoon.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Thank you, sir. And if I might say, sir, Mister Holmes is on his way.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Is he.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: He has been making tea, sir.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Making tea.

lines.speaker: WILKINS
lines.text: Yes, sir. And he said a thing I did not follow at the time, sir, about it being easier to take a wrong idea away from a man than to stop him having it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There was a pause of some length.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Doctor Watson. I feel very sorry for Lord Beryl. It will be quite a scandal when this appears in the papers.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: It certainly will.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: One does wonder, though.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Wonder what, Inspector?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Why a woman who will not say one word in her own defence was so very quick to confess.

episodes.title: Oberstein Was Not Shot
episodes.source_range: case two, eight minutes forty seconds to twelve minutes ten seconds
episodes.summary: Holmes remarks, more or less to himself, that he wonders why Lady Beryl lied. Watson makes him repeat it. What follows is a short lesson in ballistics that takes the entire case apart.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Lord Beryl learned that his wife had confessed to shooting Herr Oberstein in his study. Lestrade had a tidy case, an Austrian revolver, and a wife who would say nothing else.
episodes.end_hook: If Lady Beryl did not do it, then somebody in that house did, and the confession was designed to stop anyone looking for him.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Holmes is patient and merciless. Lestrade gets quieter as it goes on.
episodes.production_note: PREDICTED WEAK EPISODE. The ballistics reasoning is a lecture. Holmes is correct at length while nothing physically happens. Predicted before measurement, deliberately not repaired.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is a shame she must remain in prison. Still, she may decide to tell you. I do wonder why Lady Beryl lied to you.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I said nothing.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: You did. Just now. You said you wondered why Lady Beryl lied.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Oh. That. Yes.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: What do you mean, lied? She confessed.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: She did. And it was a lie. Lady Beryl did not shoot Herr Oberstein.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Now see here.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: She did not shoot him because he was not shot. His skull was broken with a blunt instrument. The revolver you have been calling the murder weapon belonged to Oberstein himself. She found it lying beside him, drew the obvious conclusion, and confessed in order to shield her husband.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Good heavens.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: She is no more guilty than you are, Doctor. Rather less, since you at least were in the building.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Would you mind repeating that?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Which part?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: All of it. Slowly.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You told me Lady Beryl confessed to shooting Oberstein. But Oberstein was not shot. Because you found a man with the back of his head shattered and a gun lying beside him, you assumed the two facts were connected. They are not.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: But the bullet, Holmes. It had not emerged through the front of the skull. We assumed it had lodged.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You assumed. And here is the difficulty with that assumption. Any student of elementary ballistics knows that the greatest damage to a skull is on the side opposite to the one the bullet entered. The point of entry is always small and always clean.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And there was no clean entry wound.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: There was no entry wound at all. There was a great deal of damage and nothing to explain it but a heavy object swung by somebody standing close enough to be trusted.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: But the gun we found was an Austrian gun. And Lady Beryl is an Austrian. Now there is a logical bit of reasoning for you.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is not reasoning, Inspector, it is rhyming. Oberstein was Austrian. Oberstein was a man who bought and sold state papers for a living, and such men are in the habit of going armed. Whose revolver would you expect to find in his coat?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: His own.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: His own. It fell from his pocket when he went down.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And Lady Beryl came in and saw it lying there.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: And saw a dead man, and a revolver, and jumped to precisely the same conclusion the Inspector did, in rather less time and with rather better excuse, since she had reason to be frightened and he had not.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: You are saying my whole case rests on a mistake a distressed woman made in the dark.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I am saying you and she made the same mistake, Inspector. She made hers in ten seconds. You have had all afternoon.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Then Lady Beryl is innocent.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Lady Beryl is innocent. And somebody else is guilty, and that somebody has spent this afternoon watching you build a case against a woman who was doing him the greatest favour of his life.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: We must get back to the premises and examine them for clues.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: We are standing in the premises.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Then we must examine them.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You have had eleven men examining them since one o'clock. They have moved the body, cleaned the carpet and tidied the desk. What I require now is not a search. It is a list of everybody who was in this house.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Holmes, if the confession was meant to protect Lord Beryl.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Then she believed her husband capable of it, which is interesting. And she was wrong, which is more interesting still. Because it means the person she was protecting him from is somebody she never once considered.

episodes.title: Search The Garden
episodes.source_range: case two, twelve minutes ten seconds to nineteen minutes
episodes.summary: Lady Beryl is released and still will not explain herself. Holmes asks Lord Beryl a question about his reading glasses, sends every constable in the house out to search a garden for nothing in particular, and asks to meet the secretary.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Holmes demonstrated that Oberstein was never shot at all, that the revolver was the dead man's own, and that Lady Beryl had confessed to a murder she did not commit in order to shield her husband.
episodes.end_hook: Holmes has sent eleven policemen to look for anything that does not belong in a garden, and he has not told one of them what he expects them to find.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Courteous on the surface, with Holmes quietly setting a trap nobody notices.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Lady Beryl. We are releasing you.

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: So I understand.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Do you know why?

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Because we have been able to prove that you did not commit the murder you confessed to. We should however like an explanation as to why you confessed to it.

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: I prefer not to explain my actions.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: You realise that your actions are in themselves punishable, and that we could detain you for them.

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: And you still prefer to make no statement.

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And she said nothing else at all. Holmes had told me on the way over that she would not, and had seemed rather to admire it.

scenes.title: Do You Use Glasses When You Read

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You are in the Foreign Office, Lord Beryl.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Had you ever met Herr Oberstein before?

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: Once. Last week. For the first and the last time.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It was his habit, I believe, to offer large sums of money to men in key positions for whatever they had access to.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: That was his habit.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Thank you. Has there been any attempt at forced entry into this house?

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: None.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Have you examined your safe?

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: I have. Every paper is intact.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Excellent. Lord Beryl, do you use glasses when you read?

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: These are your only pair?

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: They are. Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Because I find it a useful question. Who has the combination to your safe?

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: My secretary, Mister Ross. There has been no question of robbery.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Of course not. One must ask these things.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Inspector. How many men have you on the premises?

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Eleven. Two outside. Why?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Good. I wonder if you would mind taking all of them into the garden behind this window and making a formal search of the ground, to a radius of thirty feet.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Looking for what?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Anything that does not belong in a garden.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Are you serious, Holmes?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Completely.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: That is the vaguest instruction I have ever been given in twenty years of service.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It is. If I told them what to find, they would find it, and a good defence counsel would spend a pleasant morning explaining to a jury exactly how they came to.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: And if you tell them nothing?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Then whatever they bring me, they brought me. Off you go, Inspector.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: This is my secretary, Mister Ross. Inspector Lestrade, Doctor Watson, and this gentleman is Mister Sherlock Holmes.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: How do you do. I understand it is through your efforts that Lady Beryl is returning home.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Partially through my efforts.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: The household is very much in your debt, sir.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Mister Ross, I wonder if I might impose upon you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Anything at all.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Would you take these sheets of paper and lay them out roughly in the position in which you discovered the body.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Outline it? In scraps of paper?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: If you would be so kind.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Of course. Though I confess I do not see the purpose of it.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: No. Very few people do.

episodes.title: The Difference Between Success and Disaster
episodes.source_range: case two, nineteen minutes to twenty four minutes thirty nine seconds
episodes.summary: Holmes asks Lady Beryl to stand where she stood. The secretary corrects her position, and then corrects it again, and in being helpful twice too often he hangs himself.
episodes.prev_episode_summary: Holmes asked Lord Beryl about his reading glasses, sent every constable into the garden to look for anything that did not belong there, and invited the secretary to lay out the position of the body in scraps of paper.
episodes.end_hook: The case is closed, the credit is misfiled as usual, and there is a flame still burning under an experiment in Baker Street.
episodes.style_prompt: Read as a nineteen fifties radio detective drama. Quiet and exact, tightening line by line, then breaking into comedy at the very end.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Lady Beryl. If it would not be too much of an imposition, I should like you to take up the position in which Mister Ross discovered you.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: Mister Holmes, my wife has had a harrowing experience. Consider her nerves.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You are forgetting, Lord Beryl, that your wife confessed to a crime she did not commit. The circumstances are somewhat exceptional. But if Lady Beryl would rather not.

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: It is quite all right, George.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: She crossed the room without hurrying, and stopped, and stood very straight.

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: I was standing here.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Exactly there?

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: I believe so.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Mister Ross. Are you quite certain that is the position in which Lady Beryl was standing?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well. If you will pardon my saying so, sir, and only for the sake of accuracy, you understand.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: For the sake of accuracy. Please.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I believe her ladyship was standing a little further to her left.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: A little to your left, Lady Beryl. Like that?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yes. I would say just about there.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Good. And she had a revolver in her hand.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: In which hand?

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: My right hand.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: That is right. Her ladyship's right hand.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I remember thinking that the man had a remarkable memory, and that it was a fortunate thing for everyone that he did.

scenes.title: There Were No Glasses On The Floor

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: And where in relation to the body was the pair of broken eyeglasses?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Over there. There, I think.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The room went entirely still, and I understood, a good deal later than everybody else, exactly what had been done.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Mister Ross. Were there any glasses on the floor when you found the body?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Absolutely not.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: You are positive.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Positive. I did not know what I was saying just then.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: There were no glasses on the floor when you found Lady Beryl bending over the body. But there were glasses on the floor when Herr Oberstein went down, because he had put them on to read the papers he had come here to buy from you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: That is a lie.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: He paid you. You struck him. He fell, and the glasses broke, and his revolver dropped from his pocket. You put the papers back in the safe, you pocketed the money, and you gathered up the pieces of the frames and threw them into the garden.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Where eleven of my men have just spent forty minutes finding them.

lines.speaker: LADY_BERYL
lines.text: I thought the gun was my husband's. It was similar. It was not the same.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: A very common pattern of frame, and a very common pattern of revolver. You read the evidence incorrectly, Lady Beryl. So did Scotland Yard. You had the better excuse.

lines.speaker: LORD_BERYL
lines.text: My humble and very grateful thanks, Mister Holmes.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It has been a pleasure.

lines.speaker: LESTRADE
lines.text: Brilliant, Holmes. Absolutely brilliant.

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: It was the little things, Inspector. It is always the little things. They are the difference between success and disaster, and one must never forget.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He stopped. He had gone very pale.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: Holmes? What is it?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: I have left the gas on under the experiment.

lines.speaker: WATSON
lines.text: You have what?

lines.speaker: HOLMES
lines.text: Baker Street will be blown up.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It was not blown up. It was, however, a near enough thing that our landlady raised the rent, and Holmes paid the increase without a word of complaint, which in the whole of our acquaintance he did exactly once.
